questions.q: Why does this series begin with Prophet Ibrahim AS?
options: Because Ibrahim was born in Makkah
Because Prophet Muhammad SAW was born in Ibrahim's time
Because the Prophet SAW described himself as the answer to Ibrahim's prayer
Because the Kaabah was built by Prophet Muhammad SAW
questions.explain: The Prophet SAW described himself as the answer to his father Ibrahim's prayer, so the place and the time must be understood first.

questions.q: According to the opening of this lecture, which two blessings do people forget the most?
questions.explain: Good health and free time. We often appreciate them only when they run low.

questions.q: After being sure that Allah would not let them be lost, what did Hajar do?
options: Ran back and forth between Safa and Marwah looking for water
Asked the Jurhum Arabs for help
questions.explain: Hajar still made the effort, going back and forth seven times between Safa and Marwah, and then the water of Zamzam gushed forth.

questions.q: What is the name of the ritual of Hajj and Umrah that commemorates Hajar's search for water?
questions.explain: Sa'i is walking seven times between Safa and Marwah. Hajar's unseen effort was raised by Allah into a rite of worship.

questions.q: Which tribe came and asked Hajar to let them settle in Makkah?
questions.explain: The Jurhum Arabs came from Yemen asking to settle, and Hajar made clear that the water was hers.

questions.q: Why did Amr bin Luhayy bring the idol Hubal from Rome to Makkah?
options: Because Prophet Ismail AS told him to
Because the Jurhum asked him to
Because he wanted to protect the trade caravans
Because he felt inferior when he saw how advanced Rome was
questions.explain: Amr bin Luhayy admired Rome's progress and brought back its idol. The ustaz links it to our habit of assuming outsiders know better.

questions.q: Prophet Ibrahim's prayer for his descendants put provision before prayer and faith.
questions.explain: False. Prophet Ibrahim's prayer put his descendants' prayer and faith before provision.

questions.q: Prophet Ibrahim's prayer for a messenger to be sent was answered after about 2,000 years.
questions.explain: True. That prayer, Al-Baqarah 129, took more than 2,000 years before Prophet Muhammad SAW was sent.

questions.q: Put these events in the right order.

items.text: Ibrahim and Ismail build the Kaabah
Hajar and Ismail are left in the valley
Amr bin Luhayy brings Hubal to Makkah
The Jurhum Arabs settle in Makkah
Sa'i between Safa and Marwah, and Zamzam gushes forth

questions.explain: Hajar and Ismail were left, Zamzam gushed forth, the Jurhum settled, Ibrahim and Ismail built the Kaabah, and much later Hubal was brought to Makkah.

questions.q: Match each term with its meaning.

right.text: Entrusting the matter to Allah after making the effort
Walking seven times between Safa and Marwah

questions.explain: Tauriah is a statement with two meanings, sa'i is walking between Safa and Marwah, tawakkul is entrusting the matter to Allah after making the effort, and Khalilullah is Allah's closest friend.

questions.q: You have tried your very best to find halal provision but have not succeeded yet. Which attitude best matches Hajar's tawakkul?
options: Keep striving with everything you have, then leave the rest to Allah
Stop trying, because everything is already decided
Take a haram route to succeed quickly
questions.explain: True tawakkul is maximum effort, with the rest left to Allah. Hajar was sure, yet still went to Safa and Marwah.
